package.name: depth_estimation_node
package.description: Robust monocular depth estimation (Depth Anything V2 + CLAHE/Zero-DCE enhancement) as a ROS 2 node for the Sherpa RP. Publishes an enhanced monocular depth estimate, scale-calibrated live against the RealSense D435i's own stereo depth, plus an advisory near-field obstacle flag for the RealSense's 0.25-0.70m detection band. Intended as a low-light /adverse-condition fallback source alongside realsense_obstacle_detector, not a replacement for it -- see README.md before wiring into cmd_vel_safety_gate.
